description:
Distributed brute-force: 5 attacker IPs each try 4 failed logins
against 'admin'. Total of 20 failed authentications targeting the
same account, but no individual IP exceeds the brute_force threshold
(5 within 60s).

The SIEM is expected to NOT detect this as an attack — brute_force
rule groups by source IP, not by username. This is a documented
limitation in Chapter 7 (Future work).

Mitigations discussed in the thesis: aggregate per-username rules,
global rate-limiters, or behavioral baselines that flag rare
failure-success patterns regardless of IP.

Note: The traffic is sent directly to the webapp (port 9000) so
the X-Forwarded-For header carries the spoofed attacker IP. Going
through Nginx (port 8080) would have Nginx rewrite the header.
